kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 700. At Rs 700: market cap Rs 4,009.75 cr, P/E 78.8x FY26 diluted EPS Rs 8.88, P/B 7.25x, EV/EBITDA 39.1x FY26. Pre-IPO secondary transfers to institutions on 29-30 Sep 2026 were also at Rs 700 (pp. 151-152).

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: IP bought from CEAQ Singapore (formerly Tonbo Imaging Pte; an enterprise with substantial interest, selling shareholder) for Rs 1,831.91 m in Mar-2024, valued by DCF (MPEEM, 10-year life) and capitalised: 54.4% of FY24 total expenses. Material purchases from CEAQ Singapore continue: Rs 789.80 m in FY26 (26.3% of total expenses) and Rs 171.99 m in Q1 FY27 (28.2%).

focus.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
focus.detail: No goodwill. Intangible assets Rs 1,627.01 m at 31-Mar-2026 = 29.4% of net worth, mostly the related-party IP purchase; amortisation lifts D&A from Rs 133.95 m (FY24) to Rs 313.35 m (FY26).

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Top-10 customers 77.83% of FY26 revenue and 98.17% in Q1 FY27 (top-1 54.74%); Indian Government 71.19% of FY26 revenue; foreign-government revenue fell from Rs 2,676.93 m to Rs 121.14 m. Top-10 suppliers 68.77% of FY26 total expenses with no long-term supply contracts.

focus.title: Contingent liabilities
focus.detail: Bank guarantees Rs 789.34 m = 14.7% of 30-Jun-2026 net worth; GST disputes Rs 8.32 m; a customs notice received 23-Jul-2026 is disclosed as a contingent liability without an amount. Materiality threshold Rs 32.03 m (p. 447).

issues.issuer: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd

strengths: 100% ownership of IP since Mar-2024 across optics, IR engines and video processing (pp. 138, 246)
Largest supplier of thermal imaging systems to Indian government agencies Apr-24 to Mar-26; 94% of Indian thermal-imaging exports by units FY24-26 (issuer-paid F&S report, p. 246)
28,000+ systems deployed in 24 countries; ITAR-free portfolio (p. 246)
Cash tax 23.3% of cumulative FY24-26 PBT; no auditor qualifications or auditor change (pp. 89, 100, 440)
weaknesses: Cumulative CFO -Rs 121.00 cr against PAT Rs 192.18 cr FY24-26 (p. 90)
Revenue -22.69% in FY26; Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 36.01 cr and loss Rs 17.74 cr (pp. 89, 144)
Top-10 customers 77.83% of FY26 and 98.17% of Q1 FY27 revenue (p. 24)
Purchases from related party CEAQ Singapore Rs 78.98 cr = 26.3% of FY26 expenses (p. 94)
Inventory Rs 319.63 cr at 30-Jun-2026 vs Rs 111.14 cr at 31-Mar-2025 (p. 87)
opportunities: India EO/IR market $522 m (CY2020) to $1.4 bn (CY2030), 10.5% CAGR - issuer-paid F&S report (p. 205)
Orders of Rs 118.15 cr received Jul-Sep 2026, incl. a Rs 51.44 cr export order deferred from FY26 (pp. 23, 250)
Platform systems grew from Rs 12.70 cr (FY24) to Rs 144.81 cr (FY26) (p. 248)
IDDM eligibility under DAP 2020 favours indigenous OEMs (p. 247)
threats: Tender-based, non-recurring contracts; bid-win ratio 14.29% in Q1 FY27 vs 40.91% in FY24 (p. 23)
Export orders exposed to conflicts and export approvals: foreign-government revenue Rs 267.69 cr -> Rs 12.11 cr FY25-26 (p. 251)
Singapore High Court suit by a CEAQ Singapore minority shareholder naming the company, MD and a nominee director (p. 448)
Lock-in expiries: 287 lakh pre-issue shares (50% of capital) free after six months (p. 121)
